subject.title: [Feature]: Plugin API for aborting agent runs (api.runtime.agent.abort)

question: Should OpenClaw expose an injected plugin runtime API for aborting agent runs, and what scope should prevent cross-plugin or cross-session cancellation?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the safe design depends on product and security intent around plugin authority, run ownership, and whether existing Gateway/session cancellation should remain the only public boundary.

options.title: Approve scoped runtime API
options.body: Add `api.runtime.agent.abort` only with explicit plugin/session ownership checks, docs, API baseline coverage, and tests for allowed and denied cancellation.

options.title: Keep Gateway/session boundary
options.body: Do not add an injected runtime abort method; document `sessions.abort`/`chat.abort` or a future session-run-cancel seam as the supported cancellation path.

options.title: Defer to session-run-cancel design
options.body: Wait for the open session-run-cancel SDK proposal to settle before adding another public cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped runtime API
recommendation.body: Add `api.runtime.agent.abort` only with explicit plugin/session ownership checks, docs, API baseline coverage, and tests for allowed and denied cancellation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history shows the strongest combined ownership signal across plugin runtime docs, SDK helper surfaces, and adjacent session/gateway work.
